proof_scope: Two cutoff levels prove local W2,2 from metric L2 Laplacian without assuming first derivatives: first-order commutator lies in H-1, giving H1; a nested cutoff then gives L2 right side and H2. Positive current coefficients are PSD almost everywhere; bounded metric trace gives bounded complex coefficients. Verified weak zero-set locality yields the regular mixed contact density n!/pi^n D, with arbitrary non-psh barriers and contact-restricted locally bounded positive determinants. No general elliptic W2,p, unrestricted barrier determinant integrability, envelope PDE regularity or arbitrary irregular psh contact is inferred. No external input.
